method: Single reference point at VERITAS's own official published coordinate (site:mount-hopkins-veritas, precision_m 100); stands in for the four-telescope array as a whole. The individual T1-T4 positions are known only as pairwise inter-telescope distances (35-127 m before the 2009 T1 relocation, 81-127 m after; Perkins 2009, arXiv:0912.3841) with no absolute coordinates or angles published, and no OpenStreetMap trace of the telescope pads could be attempted this session (Overpass refused every connection) -- not enough to derive four individual positions honestly, so they are not drawn separately (see worklog backlog).
name: VERITAS array (reference point)
notes: Individual T1-T4 positions not resolved this session; only pairwise inter-telescope distances are published (35-127 m). Backlog: an OSM trace of the telescope pads, or a paper/diagram with absolute coordinates or bearings.

summary.plain: The four VERITAS gamma-ray telescopes at the Fred Lawrence Whipple Observatory basecamp, shown here as a single reference point.
